question: What happens at death to one initiated by this initiation and remembering the knowledge triad?
premises: The initiated person remembers the threefold knowledge in the heart.
External worship and the like are not required.
At the body's end that person goes to the supreme abode.
inference: Initiation plus inward remembrance leads to the supreme abode without outer ritual.
uncertainties: bāhyārcādi may depend on a different case than shown.
vrajati may have an implied subject other than the initiate.
plain_english: One initiated by this initiation, remembering the threefold knowledge in the heart, goes to the supreme abode at the end of the body without external worship and the like.
